data.description: Verifies the sealed real WebView2/MCP acceptance executed by the workspace runner on both SQLite/text, matching source files, native/MCP binary hashes, frontend entry and retained logs. Run scripts/check_markdown_feature.ps1 -Suite Native from the workspace first. The installed QA host stalls when starting some nested Node/Python processes, so this job records and verifies their actual externally executed evidence. Covers documents, toolbar/Preview, guarded drafts, import, references, projections and large bodies.
data.name: Markdown native desktop acceptance
